_doc: P0 cluster / element inventory and default stacking (brief section 6), checked against the rectified references. z = stack order inside a dial (6.2 numbering; fractions = inserted layers). class: baked | procedural | dynamic. evidence: strong | ok | weak. best_refs: rect crop bases under bake/work/rect/ (see refs.json naming). R-unit numbers marked 'P0 measured' come from radial luminance profiles of the rectified crops (upper sector 300-60 deg cw12); refine per element.

rpm_majors_cw12_05.note: ~1.3 deg earlier than theme RPM_START 250.5 + 32.1 k; 05's roll is known to ~1 deg

p0_measured_R_units.clean_render_02_differs: 02 (render) has disc edge 0.568, floor edge 0.134, strong ticks to 0.903: its proportions differ from the photos; use 02 for gradients / glow / colour, the photos (17, 05, 04, 03) for geometry

C5.name: centre window (frame, floor / horizon light bars, glow)
C5.note: C5 crops use the 6WB layout scaled by dial R and centred on the dial-pair midpoint: the 6WB dials land at x ~435 / ~1485 (6WB dial spacing 3.05-3.18 R, median ~3.11 R; ours 3.27 R), so the 6WB gap between the dials is ~55 px narrower each side at R 335; fit window shapes in their own frame, not absolute x.

C6.name: bottom row: range arc under the speedo, EfficientDynamics + l/100km arc under the tach, Time / Trip / Temp bar
C6.note: the two arcs live inside the dials' bottom gap (C1/C2 crops, ~0.82-0.92 R, ~150-210 deg cw12); the info bar is in the window (C5 crop).

C7.name: signs and icons (speed limit, no overtaking, fuel pump, oil can, coolant, battery, belt)

C8.name: mode parts: Sport band / bridge / wings; Eco Pro CHARGE-POWER arc, EfficientDynamics inner arc

dial_stack.notes: dark blue-black, slight lift toward the middle. Levels: take from 05 / 03 / 04 (face L ~5-12 after normalisation); 17 and 07 carry veiling glare (face L 50-72 / 19-21).
AO inside the bezel, visible in 05 / 13 as the darker band just inside the groove.

NEW: the face below the horizon line is darker across the whole face width (to ~0.7 R), not only inside the disc: 05 above/below the line L 7/3 at |u| 0.5-0.7, 17 C1 70/47. The crisp edge itself is only inside ~0.45 R (layer 8). Keep it below the groove / ticks (it stops inside 0.80 R).
13: dark recessed band at the ticks' outer ends with a grey outer rim; inner rim at 0.80 R (17, 05, 03).
05: red fill between the tick ends from ~7000 rpm; start is a setting.
13 @4x: wedge ticks with a cool (cyan) fringe at the outer end, a blurred light spot just past the long ticks' ends, on the groove. Minor pitch 3.2 deg (rev).
range arc (C1) and EfficientDynamics + l/100km arc (C2) in the bottom gap, same radial band as the ticks; draw with the ticks. Variant-specific: 17/07 tick scale, 02 white+red bar, 12 orange bar.

dial_stack.id: C2 OFF arc + READY / OFF marks
dial_stack.notes: 05: thin arc from the READY tick back to the OFF mark, ~0.86-0.89 R.
edge at ~0.49 R (0.473-0.51), not 0.51. In 6WB it is an ARC open at the bottom: it ends at the floor line on both sides (17, 05, 04); the current shader draws a full ring.
thin ring at ~0.33 R in 05 (theme 0.36); also ends at the floor line. Weak in the other photos; 14 is the close-up (scale assumes the disc edge at 0.51 R: rescale by 0.49/0.51 if P1 confirms 0.49).
horizontal edge at 0.236-0.257 R below centre (theme 0.26), crisp inside the disc; above layers 6-7 (they end at it). See z 2.5 for the wide darkening.
15 @4x: thin red ring at 0.133 R, dark middle with two red fans; ring glow state may be dynamic.
not baked. Every rect crop masks a corridor around it (maskbits 8). The 6WB tail reaches ~0.25-0.32 R past the hub (17, 02).

thin bright ring, ridge at 0.99 R, outer half-max edge = R. Bezel brightness vs angle: 02 (render) brightest upper-left / top (130 deg math), but the photos 17 / 04 / 03 brightest at the bottom toward the window (~268 deg): reflections dominate there. Verify the key light from the gloss profile across the tube, not from the ridge brightness.
07, 17, 03 (sport) show glass glare; masked as glare where saturated.
